main_measure.name: mean short-signed next-day return minus the coin's mean daily return, on forecast < 0 bars

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over at least 30 case-days; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of short-signed excess next-day return on depth last_history_value

decided_by: The main mean is positive with t >= 2 over at least 30 case-days and the supporting slope is above 0.
reading: Situation checked from prices as an up close after at least 2 down closes inside the window, with short side (forecast < 0); the falling-calm profile is not recomputed (its 365-day volatility percentile needs history before each window) and active bars in a window's first 3 rows are left out of the check; case-days are distinct UTC dates, the t is clustered by day (deviations summed per day), the slope is OLS over all cases, and fewer than 30 case-days gives 'not observable' as the workflow's minimum-count rule requires.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.002493 on the check folds against +0.006286 on every fold
